name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each to land-holding farmer families.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers with cultivable land
Family income should be based on land holding criteria
All land-holding farmer families are eligible
Excluded: income tax payers, constitutional post holders, government employees
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or online at pmkisan.gov.in

name: PM Awas Yojana Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/difficult areas) for construction of pucca houses to rural homeless families.
eligibility: Houseless families or families living in kutcha/dilapidated houses
Listed in Socio Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011
SC/ST families, freed bonded labourers, minorities prioritized
Must not own a pucca house in any part of India
benefits: ₹1.20-1.30 lakh for house construction + MGNREGS support
how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat or online at pmayg.nic.in

name: PM Awas Yojana Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS) providing interest subsidy on home loans for Economically Weaker Section (EWS) and Low Income Group (LIG) urban beneficiaries.
eligibility: EWS: Annual income up to ₹3 lakh
LIG: Annual income ₹3 lakh to ₹6 lakh
MIG-I: Annual income ₹6 lakh to ₹12 lakh
Must not own a pucca house in India
benefits: Interest subsidy up to 6.5% on home loans up to ₹6 lakh
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, housing finance companies or pmaymis.gov.in

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
description: Free food grain distribution of 5 kg per person per month to beneficiaries under the National Food Security Act (NFSA).
eligibility: Priority Household (PHH) ration card holders
Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) card holders
Covered under National Food Security Act (NFSA)
benefits: 5 kg free rice/wheat per person per month
how_to_apply: No application needed. Collect from designated Fair Price Shop (FPS) with ration card.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accidental insurance, ₹30,000 life insurance, and ₹10,000 overdraft facility.
eligibility: Any Indian citizen above 10 years of age
Does not have an existing bank account
No income requirement
benefits: Zero balance account + RuPay card + ₹2L accident insurance + ₹10K overdraft
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Business Correspondent (BC) outlet

name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free micro-loans for small businesses. Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishore (₹50,000 to ₹5 lakh), Tarun (₹5 lakh to ₹10 lakh).
eligibility: Non-corporate, non-farm small or micro enterprises
Individuals, proprietary firms, partnership firms
No prior loan default history
benefits: Loans up to ₹10 lakh without collateral for business purposes
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, NBFC, MFI branch or online at mudra.org.in

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: Cashless health insurance coverage of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation at empanelled hospitals.
eligibility: Bottom 40% of India's population as per SECC data
Rural: D1 to D5 deprivation categories in SECC
Urban: Occupational categories listed in SECC
No family size or age restrictions for beneficiaries
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or visit nearest empanelled hospital

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60 for unorganised sector workers.
eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18-40 years
Must have a savings bank account
Not an income tax payer
Not covered under EPF/ESIC
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension ₹1,000-₹5,000 after 60 years of age
how_to_apply: Enroll through any bank branch, internet banking, or mobile banking app

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Voluntary pension scheme for unorganised workers with guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 after age 60.
eligibility: Unorganised sector workers aged 18-40 years
Monthly income up to ₹15,000
Not covered under ESIC, EPFO, NPS, or income tax
benefits: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension after 60 + ₹2 lakh family pension on death
documents: Savings bank account or Jan Dhan account
how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or maandhan.in

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance at very low premium (1.5-5%) protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas
Both loanee (compulsory) and non-loanee farmers
Sharecroppers and tenant farmers also eligible
benefits: Full insured amount on crop failure from natural causes
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest bank, CSC, or online at pmfby.gov.in before cut-off date

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) Schemes
description: Single platform for multiple central and state scholarships for Pre-Matric, Post-Matric, and Merit-cum-Means students.
eligibility: Indian students at various education levels
Pre-Matric: Students from Class 1 to 10
Post-Matric: Students from Class 11 onwards
Family income criteria varies by scheme (₹1-2.5 lakh/year)
benefits: Scholarships from ₹1,000 to ₹20,000/year depending on scheme

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accidental death and disability insurance coverage of ₹2 lakh at just ₹20/year premium.
eligibility: Bank account holders aged 18-70 years
Savings bank account with Aadhaar
Auto-debit consent required annually
benefits: ₹2 lakh on accidental death / full disability; ₹1 lakh on partial disability
how_to_apply: Enroll through bank branch, net banking, or mobile banking at ₹20/year

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance coverage of ₹2 lakh for death from any cause at ₹436/year premium.
eligibility: Bank account holders aged 18-50 years
Aadhaar-linked savings bank account
Annual auto-renewal with consent
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance coverage for any cause of death
how_to_apply: Enroll through any bank branch or online banking at ₹436/year

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Free soil health cards issued to farmers with crop-wise recommendations for nutrients and fertilizers to improve productivity.
eligibility: All farmers with agricultural land
No income restriction
benefits: Free soil testing and nutrient recommendations to improve yield
how_to_apply: Contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture office
